Palo Alto police are suing the city claiming a #BlackLivesMatter mural discriminates against them.

The mural includes Assata Shakur, a Black Liberation Army leader convicted in 1977 by an all-white jury for killing a state trooper. She escaped prison and got asylum in Cuba. https://t.co/dBTVtYrI0r

The #climatecrisis worsened these disasters in July alone:

▪️Flooding becomes one of Germany’s worst natural disasters in years
▪️UK issues 1st-ever extreme heat warning
▪️Wildfires send smoke 2,500 miles to U.S. East Coast
▪️1 year’s worth of rain falls in just 3 days in China https://t.co/XQsN49gKwd

A man accused of filing a false police report on #BLM protesters in Schenectady, NY last year violated their civil rights, a judge ruled.

He was ordered to pay the 9 activists $500 each after the state AG’s lawsuit alleged he threatened protesters with a baton and air rifle. https://t.co/9pUJDj7bE7

The leader of the white supremacist Proud Boys group has been sentenced to 5+ months in jail for burning a #BlackLivesMatter banner.

The sign was stolen from a historic Black church during DC protests on Dec. 12 supporting then-Pres. Trump's unfounded claims of election fraud. https://t.co/lKyTwY2UyX

A Beijing court has ruled against a woman who accused a prominent TV presenter of sexually harassing her when she was an intern in 2014, citing "insufficient" evidence.

The case was a landmark for China's #MeToo movement. Zhou Xiaoxuan said her team would appeal the verdict. https://t.co/9zsJY06vMB

@GretaThunberg Only 1 country has a plan compatible with the Paris climate agreement, says a watchdog: Gambia, which produces about 0% of global C02 emissions.

Young people are protesting their governments' failure to tackle the #ClimateCrisis:

🇹🇷 Turkey
🇮🇹 Italy
🇵🇹 Portugal
🇵🇱 Poland https://t.co/K5BCRgusVa
